# E5-LS4-T5 grounded source cards

## MED_NATURE_SKIN - Dermatologist-level classification of skin cancer with deep neural networks
- Source: Nature (2017)
- URL: https://www.nature.com/articles/nature21056
- Type: peer_reviewed_study
- Notes: Nature paper on deep neural networks for skin-cancer image classification; it does not claim universal diagnosis for all cancers.

## MED_JAMA_DR - Development and Validation of a Deep Learning Algorithm for Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy in Retinal Fundus Photographs
- Source: JAMA (2016)
- URL: https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/fullarticle/2588763
- Type: peer_reviewed_study
- Notes: JAMA validation study for diabetic retinopathy detection in retinal fundus photographs; the scope is image-based screening.

## MED_FDA_AI - Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Medical Devices
- Source: U.S. FDA (2025)
- URL: https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/software-medical-device-samd/artificial-intelligence-and-machine-learning-aiml-enabled-medical-devices
- Type: regulatory_reference
- Notes: FDA list and overview for AI-enabled medical devices authorized for marketing in the United States.

## MED_WHO_ETHICS - Ethics and governance of artificial intelligence for health
- Source: WHO (2021)
- URL: https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240029200
- Type: policy_guidance
- Notes: WHO guidance says AI for health has promise but must put ethics and human rights at the heart of design, deployment, and use.

## MED_NASEM_DIAG - Improving Diagnosis in Health Care
- Source: National Academies (2015)
- URL: https://nap.nationalacademies.org/catalog/21794/improving-diagnosis-in-health-care
- Type: consensus_report
- Notes: Consensus report on diagnostic error and improving the diagnostic process across care settings.

## REMOTE_NATURE_HYBRID - Hybrid working from home improves retention without damaging performance
- Source: Nature (2024)
- URL: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-07500-2
- Type: randomized_controlled_trial
- Notes: Trip.com randomized experiment found hybrid work reduced quit rates by about one-third and did not damage performance grades; it is not evidence of a universal 30% productivity gain.

## REMOTE_STANFORD_EVOLUTION - The Evolution of Working from Home
- Source: Stanford SIEPR (2023)
- URL: https://siepr.stanford.edu/publications/working-paper/evolution-working-home
- Type: working_paper
- Notes: Research synthesis distinguishing hybrid schedules from fully remote work and emphasizing variation by task and work arrangement.

## ENERGY_IEA_RENEWABLES - Renewables 2024
- Source: IEA (2024)
- URL: https://www.iea.org/reports/renewables-2024
- Type: energy_report
- Notes: IEA flagship report forecasting renewable growth through 2030 and highlighting the policy gap to tripling targets.

## ENERGY_IEA_ELECTRICITY - Electricity chapter from Renewables 2024
- Source: IEA (2024)
- URL: https://www.iea.org/reports/renewables-2024/electricity
- Type: energy_report
- Notes: IEA electricity chapter says solar PV and wind are forecast to account for 95% of renewable capacity additions through 2030.

## ENERGY_EMBER_GER - Global Electricity Review 2024
- Source: Ember (2024)
- URL: https://ember-energy.org/latest-insights/global-electricity-review-2024
- Type: analysis_report
- Notes: Ember reports renewables generated a record 30% of global electricity in 2023, driven by wind and solar.

## ENERGY_IRENA_CAPACITY - Renewable capacity statistics 2024
- Source: IRENA (2024)
- URL: https://www.irena.org/Publications/2024/Mar/Renewable-capacity-statistics-2024
- Type: statistics_report
- Notes: IRENA statistical report on renewable capacity additions and regional distribution.
